name: Leather Luggage Tag
description:
Premium Material:
  • Crafted from premium PU leather, this Leather Luggage Tag offers a sleek appearance with a durable structure for everyday travel use. 
  • The material is lightweight, wear-resistant, and designed to maintain its shape while providing a smooth and comfortable feel. 
  • Adjustable straps with secure buckle closure help keep the tag firmly attached to luggage, backpacks, handbags, or travel accessories.

 

Sizes & Dimensions:

Available in multiple sizes to suit different travel needs:

  • Small: 3.54 in × 1.89 in (9 × 4.8 cm)
  • Medium: 4.72 in × 2.75 in (12 × 7 cm)
  • Large: 5.51 in × 3.15 in (14 × 8 cm)
  • Strap Length: 8.66 in (22 cm)
  • Strap Width: 0.39 in (1 cm)
  • Thickness: 0.08 in (2 mm)

 

Printing Technology:
  • Produced using UV printing technology that delivers vibrant colors, sharp details, and long-lasting results. 
  • The printing process creates personalized designs with excellent clarity while helping maintain color durability through regular use and travel conditions.

 

Functionality Use:
  • Designed to help travelers quickly identify luggage while adding a personal touch. 
  • It can be attached to suitcases, backpacks, carry-on bags, handbags, laptop bags, school bags, and other travel accessories. 
  • The clear information window on the back securely holds identification details, making luggage easier to recognize and reducing the chance of misplaced belongings.

 

Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:

A thoughtful and personalized gift choice for frequent travelers, family members, friends, coworkers, or loved ones. Perfect for birthdays, holidays, anniversaries, graduations, Christmas, business trips, vacations, and other special occasions.

 

Specification:
  • Processing Time: 3-5 working days average after payment and information updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 7 – 15 working days average (US)
guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
